summary.text: Jason Gallion is a Republican Maryland state senator from District 35, which covers parts of Harford and Cecil counties, who has held the seat since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and county agricultural specialist, he serves on the Education, Energy, and the Environment Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jason Gallion was born in Havre de Grace, Maryland, on February 10, 1977, and graduated from Havre de Grace High School in 1995.
He earned an A.A. in political science from Harford Community College.
Gallion has owned Hopewell Farm in Level, Maryland, since 1999 and has worked as an agricultural specialist for Harford County since 2016.
Gallion assumed office in the Maryland State Senate on January 9, 2019, succeeding Linda Norman.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.
